## Clinical justification

This 65-year-old male has a three-month history of progressive unilateral right-sided gynaecomastia. There is a firm disc of glandular tissue beneath the right nipple and breast asymmetry with the right noticeably larger than the left. I have reviewed all medications and found no causative drugs. Liver, renal, and thyroid functions are within normal limits. No personal history of breast cancer recurrence.
